messages:
Maria: Hey team — unexpected travel this evening, flight moved up. Can someone cover my Sat 22:00–02:00 oncall? I can hand off notes now. :airplane:
Devon: I can pick up 22:00–00:30 if that helps. Where are the runbooks?
Ash: I can do midnight–02:00. @Maria can you drop the quick runbook and any deploys to watch?
Maria: Thanks both. Quick notes: non-blocking canary deploy scheduled at 23:15 (tag `release/2026-03-20-hotfix`). Just watch rollout and latency dashboard. Health check: /infra/latency > 400ms triggers alert.
Maria: TL;DR runbook: 1) If error rate > 5% cancel canary and rollback to `stable-v1`. 2) If nodes unhealthy, ssh ops-01 and restart the `web` pods. 3) If KV errors, try warmup endpoint.
Maria: Useful commands: ```kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/web -w``` and ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/web --to-revision=stable-v1```
Devon: Got it. Any KV cache warmup steps or script location?
Maria: Yes — warmup script in ops repo at `ops/scripts/cache_warmup.lua`. You can also hit `https://internal.redwood/api/warmup` (GET) to prefill common prefixes. I'll DM the exact script.
Ash: Note — there's a maintenance window 23:10–23:25 announced by infra; non-disruptive but overlaps canary. If maintenance overruns, abort canary.
oncall-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 23:10–23:25 (infra-patch).
Devon: Okay — I can take 22:00–23:59 then. Ash, can you extend to 23:00–02:00 so we have overlap?
Ash: Yep I can cover 23:00–02:00. I'll watch deploy from 23:00 onward.
Maria: Thank you both — leaving contact: mobile +1-555-0102 and email maria@redwood.ai. I'll put the checklist in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ops/pages/7890123
Devon: Thanks — will ping if anything noisy. Safe travels :flight_departure:
Ash: I'll update the oncall rota and add a short note in the runbook about the maintenance overlap. :thumbsup:
